overview_description.description:
Nimble is a data science company that helps school districts identify and hire teachers.

Nimble offers a data-driven applicant tracking system that makes hiring faster and smarter for school districts and charter networks nationwide.

Nimble was founded in 2017 was headquartered in California, United States.
